proposal.experiment: volatility-scaled ETF allocation using 20-session trailing volatility, a fixed 10% annualized volatility target, and capped unleveraged next-open positions on SPY, IWM and QQQ
proposal.hypothesis: A volatility-scaled version of the equal-weight ETF allocation using 20-session trailing volatility, a fixed 10% annualized volatility target, and capped unleveraged next-open positions improves excess Sharpe by at least 0.10 versus the same equal-weight ETF allocation, with positive paired uncertainty lower bound, no more than two percentage points worse drawdown, and positive improvement under doubled costs.
rejection_criteria: Paired uncertainty lower bound is non-positive
Maximum drawdown more than 2 percentage points worse than baseline
Improvement does not hold under doubled transaction costs
